title: School of Informatics PhD Funding (September 2027 entry)
institution: The University of Edinburgh, School of Informatics
about: Edinburgh's Informatics Graduate School funding round for PhD study starting September 2027. The deadline is 30 November 2026 at 23:59 for Home and international applicants; outcomes are expected by April 2027. A Home-only second round is planned for early 2027.
requirements: First round open to Home and international applicants
Centre for Doctoral Training programmes are separate and require a separate application
